notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Marina.
description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Bottomless Pool.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.
